text:
lee_sales: Helios signed an MOU for a paid pilot. They want a POC next week and a capacity plan for an enterprise commit. Key asks: sustained 400 rps embedding + spikes to 2k rps for short bursts, low 95th gen latency (<350ms), and SOC2/HIPAA notes. @nisha_se can you coordinate perf test targets and a runbook?

nisha_se: Yep — I'll run a traffic profile. Need to confirm steady-state vs peak window. Proposal: steady-state 400rps for 8h/day, peak bursts 120s at 2k rps during UA events. Also: what model variant? quantized or fp16?

pat_eng: Model plan is phi-2-7b Q4 quantized (int4). Empirical on A10G: ~55 rps per GPU for 64-token gen when cold. With KV prefix caching and batching we can push sustained ~180 rps/GPU for short sequences (embeddings higher throughput). Suggest starting reservation: 6 reserved GPUs with 3 burst slots. That gives headroom for warm cache and autoscale glue.

rachel_ops: Ops recs: spread reserved instances across 3 AZs, reserve different instance families (A10G + one p4d-style pool) to avoid correlated evictions. Preheat plan: run kv-warmup and synthetic traffic 30m before expected bursts. Warmup script: 
```bash
# warmup script (run on jump host)
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -X POST \"https://inference.redwood/servers/warm?model=phi-2-7b-q\" -d @sample_prompt.json >/dev/null; done
```
Estimate preheat cost: 180 GPU-min/day (~$XX/day) if we do daily warmups.

pat_eng: Autoscale policy draft — tune these values based on smoke tests: 
```json
{
  "scale_up": {"type": "queue_depth", "threshold": 25, "cooldown_s": 60},
  "scale_down": {"type": "idle_time", "threshold_s": 300},
  "max_extra_burst": 3,
  "min_reserve": 6
}
```
This is continuous-batching aware; queue_depth measured in requests across serving pool.

denA_security: Security checklist items from Helios: encryption in transit & at rest, KMS integration, customer-managed keys, audit logs retention 1 year, and a data flow diagram. We can fill the questionnaire but need legal to sign the DPA first. Also confirm on-prem option if they require air-gapped ingestion.

lee_sales: Pricing note — billing asked for a monthly estimate. Using 6 reserved GPUs + 3 burst, + warmup cost & network egress, rough estimate ~ $32k/month (ballpark). Finance to refine.

rachel_ops: I'll draft the preheat runbook and add the exact warmup commands and monitoring checks (cache hit ratio, tail latency). Also recommend KV cache TTL = 1h for their workload.

pat_eng: I'll run a 2-hour synthetic smoke today (steady 400rps + two 2-minute 2k spikes) and post results to this thread. Expect logs and 95/99 latency histograms.

deploy_bot: NOTE: POC infra can be provisioned tomorrow if approvals are in. Canary window available: 2024-10-05T14:00:00Z.

lee_sales: Action items: 1) Engineering run smoke test + post results (@pat_eng), 2) Ops to produce preheat runbook and cost estimate (@rachel_ops), 3) Security to start questionnaire draft and list required attestations (@dena_security), 4) Pricing/Finance to refine the monthly estimate. I'll triage third-party legal items. :thumbsup:

nisha_se: I'll schedule POC runway and invite Helios SREs to the smoke test.

pat_eng: Quick note — if we switch to a smaller sequence length (avg tokens < 30) we can cut GPU needs by ~25%. Keep that in mind for prompts.

lee_sales: Thanks team — keep updates here.
